summary: The "0.32.0 JACCL patch inventory" is the list of JACCL, launcher and Metal-synchronisation changes that a user of PyPI `mlx==0.32.0` has, lacks, or must carry as a fork patch.

facts.text: The "0.32.0 JACCL patch inventory" is the list of JACCL, launcher and Metal-synchronisation changes that a user of PyPI `mlx==0.32.0` has, lacks, or must carry as a fork patch.

In 0.32.0: PR 3459 "Add barrier to JACCL", PR 3451 "[jaccl] Fix race on local_staging in MeshImpl::all_reduce", PR 3654 "Fix multi-wire recv prefill deadlock in jaccl ring backend", PR 3523 "Catch error in CommandBuffer and poison the events", and PR 3783 "Quote hostname in mlx.launch ssh commands".

Already in earlier releases (so also in 0.32.0): PR 3412 "Jaccl refactor" with "JACCL is now a standalone lib" and PR 3418 "Fix jaccl init bug" in v0.31.2; PR 3174 "JACCL mesh bandwidth improvements" in v0.31.0; "Much faster bandwidth with JACCL on macOS >= 26.3" (PR 3094) in v0.30.6.

In 0.32.1: PR 3899 "Making JACCL coordinator optional", PR 3900 "Refactor the JACCL ring and add threads for the multiple rings", PR 4005 docs "Do not pass MLX_METAL_FAST_SYNCH=1 by default", PR 4026 (crash when reporting partial rings in `mlx.distributed_config`), PR 4027 (unique rank per host in `Hostfile.from_list`), PR 4002 (`mlx.launch --python` flag forwarded), PR 3675 (state corruption when a primitive throws during eval).
In 0.32.2: PR 4284 "Check malformed jaccl hostfile that miss rdma in pairs" and PR 4338 "Raise cpu stream errors from synchronize".
In 0.32.3: PR 4443 "Fix jaccl ring all_gather: direction 1 slice was not mirrored" and PR 4552 "[BUG][Metal] Deadlock in fence".

Not found in any release note from v0.30.4 to v0.32.3: PR 3152 (check `ibv_wc.status`), PR 4530 (JACCL liveness and progress timeout), PR 3468 (GID fallback), PR 3742 (propagate CPU errors to events), PR 4060 (ring peer loss) and PR 4191 (report when no usable GID).
The exo fork commit that said PyPI 0.32.0 has #3451 and #3654 is confirmed by the release notes.
The JACCL changes arrive in three groups: a refactor and speed work in 0.30.6 to 0.31.2, correctness fixes in 0.32.0, and ring, launcher and hostfile hygiene in 0.32.1 to 0.32.3.

0.32.0 has no JACCL peer-loss handling and no completion-status check: a dead peer or a failed work request still hangs or corrupts silently on 0.32.0 to 0.32.3 (see jaccl-silent-hang-on-peer-loss.md).
0.32.0 to 0.32.2 lack the Metal fence deadlock fix of PR 4552, which first appears in 0.32.3.
The ring `all_gather` fix (PR 4443) means 0.32.0 to 0.32.2 ring all_gather results can be wrong in direction 1; the notes do not give the trigger.
The `/releases` listing page truncates the 0.32.0 entry; its tag page `/releases/tag/v0.32.0` is the complete list.
None found between sources. The exo dossier's "patch stack removed reboots" attribution to PR 3451 is already disputed in jaccl-meshimpl-all-reduce-race-fix-mlx-3451.md.
Whether PR 4191 reached a release, since it merged on 2026-08-12 but is not in the v0.32.1 notes.
Whether the release-note titles omit PRs that touch JACCL under a generic title.
MLX v0.32.0 (2026-07-07) includes JACCL PRs 3459 (barrier), 3451 (all_reduce staging race) and 3654 (multi-wire ring recv deadlock).
MLX v0.32.0 also includes PR 3523 (poison events on command-buffer error) and PR 3783 (quote hostname in `mlx.launch` ssh commands).
The JACCL refactor (PR 3412) and init fix (PR 3418) shipped in v0.31.2, not in 0.32.0.
MLX v0.32.1 (2026-08-17) includes PRs 3899 (optional JACCL coordinator), 3900 (ring refactor with threads per ring), 4005 (docs: do not pass `MLX_METAL_FAST_SYNCH=1` by default), 4026, 4027 and 4002.
MLX v0.32.2 includes PR 4284 (reject a JACCL hostfile with unpaired rdma entries).
MLX v0.32.3 (2026-09-29) includes PR 4443 (ring `all_gather` direction-1 slice fix) and PR 4552 (Metal fence deadlock).
None of PR 3152, 4530, 3468, 3742, 4060 or 4191 appears in the release notes for v0.30.4 to v0.32.3.
The MLX `/releases` listing page truncates the v0.32.0 entry; the tag page is complete.
